nina_cs: Quick handoff for AuroraEdge private/VPC onboarding. Networking looks green but theyre blocked on two compliance asks: (1) our service getting kms:Decrypt against their CMK, (2) signed attestation that CloudTrail -> S3 retention will be immutable for 730d.
omar_se: Can you drop the exact KMS error they see?
nina_cs: They reported: `AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777666555444:key/aa11-bb22-cc33`. Hit when their pod calls /v1/keys/unseal.
ruth_kms: Likely key policy missing Redwood principal or no Grant. Ask whether CMK is in their account; if so they must add our service role to key policy OR create a grant for our role.
ci_net: Also double-check the node role has kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions. We get this a lot with EKS IRSA misconfig.
nina_cs: They gave role arn `arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/ae-infer` and said key is in their account. I suggested this minimal role snippet to attach:
```
{ "Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777666555444:key/aa11-bb22-cc33"}]}
```

ruth_kms: For their key policy (they own CMK) recommend adding: `{"Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Effect":"Allow"}`. If they prefer not to edit policy, create a grant: CreateGrant(GranteePrincipal=ourRole,Operations=[Encrypt,Decrypt]).
omar_se: About audit retention: are they using Object Lock? If not, enable S3 versioning + Object Lock (governance/compliance) and keep lifecycle rules that don't shorten retention below 730 days. They asked for a written attestation we will not remove logs once in their bucket — we can confirm behavior once Object Lock + versioning are enabled.
nina_cs: Timeline: security expects confirmation by Monday EOD or procurement may pause renewal. Marked as at-risk in tracker.
ci_net: Quick Firehose/S3 put policy snippet to share:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/firehose-redwood"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::auroraedge-audit/*"}]}
```

ruth_kms: Action items Ill own: 1) Draft one-page KMS checklist (policy + grant + test command). 2) Provide the exact Redwood service principal ARN for their key policy.
omar_se: Ill write a 1-pager for security on Object Lock, versioning, and retention implications.
ci_net: I can join a short call for the Firehose wiring.
cw-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist for AuroraEdge due in 36 hours — assign remaining items. :robot_face:
nina_cs: Thanks — I scheduled a 30m call with their security lead tomorrow 10:00 PT and will post notes. Please drop any quick clarifications here and I'll include them in the runbook. :white_check_mark:
